description: Per-residue SASA and 4 A contact analysis of human eL42 (RPL36A) chain Lo in the 80S ribosome structure 6EK0, focused on residue 38
code:
import requests, re
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

PDB="6EK0"
cif=requests.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{PDB}.cif",timeout=900).text
lines=cif.split("\n")
i=0;cols=None;start=None
while i<len(lines):
    if lines[i].startswith("_atom_site."):
        cols=[];j=i
        while lines[j].startswith("_atom_site."): cols.append(lines[j].strip().split(".")[-1]);j+=1
        start=j;break
    i+=1
recs=[]
k=start
while k<len(lines) and not lines[k].startswith("#"):
    if lines[k].strip(): recs.append(lines[k].split())
    k+=1
at=pd.DataFrame(recs,columns=cols)
at=at[at.group_PDB=="ATOM"].copy()
for c,n in [("Cartn_x","x"),("Cartn_y","y"),("Cartn_z","z")]: at[n]=at[c].astype(float)
at["resi"]=pd.to_numeric(at.label_seq_id,errors="coerce")
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
NUC={'A','U','G','C','DA','DT','DG','DC'}

el=at[at.auth_asym_id=="Lo"].copy()
modeled=el.groupby("resi").label_comp_id.first()
print(f"{PDB} chain Lo (eL42): atoms={len(el)}, residues {int(modeled.index.min())}-{int(modeled.index.max())} (n={len(modeled)})")
print("modeled seq:", "".join(AA3.get(v,'X') for v in modeled.values))
print("residue 38 modelled as:", modeled.get(38))

# ---------- Shrake-Rupley SASA ----------
RAD={'C':1.70,'N':1.55,'O':1.52,'S':1.80,'P':1.80,'MG':1.73,'ZN':1.39}
def radii(df): return df.type_symbol.str.upper().map(RAD).fillna(1.70).values
def sphere(n=400):
    idx=np.arange(0,n)+0.5; phi=np.arccos(1-2*idx/n); th=np.pi*(1+5**0.5)*idx
    return np.c_[np.cos(th)*np.sin(phi),np.sin(th)*np.sin(phi),np.cos(phi)]
SP=sphere(400); PROBE=1.4
def sasa(target_xyz,target_r,env_xyz,env_r):
    out=np.zeros(len(target_xyz))
    for a in range(len(target_xyz)):
        ra=target_r[a]+PROBE
        pts=target_xyz[a]+SP*ra
        d=np.linalg.norm(env_xyz-target_xyz[a],axis=1)
        nb=np.where((d<ra+env_r.max()+PROBE)&(d>1e-6))[0]
        acc=np.ones(len(pts),bool)
        for b in nb:
            acc &= np.linalg.norm(pts-env_xyz[b],axis=1) >= (env_r[b]+PROBE)
        out[a]=4*np.pi*ra**2*acc.mean()
    return out

elx=el[["x","y","z"]].values; elr=radii(el)
# environment = everything within 14 A of the chain
allx=at[["x","y","z"]].values; allr=radii(at)
cen=elx.mean(0); keep=np.linalg.norm(allx-cen,axis=1)<np.linalg.norm(elx-cen,axis=1).max()+16
env=at[keep]; envx=allx[keep]; envr=allr[keep]
print("environment atoms:",len(env))

s_iso=sasa(elx,elr,elx,elr)
s_cpx=sasa(elx,elr,envx,envr)
el["sasa_iso"]=s_iso; el["sasa_cpx"]=s_cpx

MAXASA={'A':129,'R':274,'N':195,'D':193,'C':167,'E':223,'Q':225,'G':104,'H':224,'I':197,'L':201,
'K':236,'M':224,'F':240,'P':159,'S':155,'T':172,'W':285,'Y':263,'V':174}
res=el.groupby("resi").agg(aa3=("label_comp_id","first"),iso=("sasa_iso","sum"),cpx=("sasa_cpx","sum"))
res["aa"]=res.aa3.map(AA3)
res["rsa_isolated"]=res.iso/res.aa.map(MAXASA)
res["rsa_in_ribosome"]=res.cpx/res.aa.map(MAXASA)
res["buried_by_ribosome"]=res.iso-res.cpx

# ---------- contacts (<=4.0 A heavy atom) ----------
other=at[at.auth_asym_id!="Lo"]
ox=other[["x","y","z"]].values
keep2=np.linalg.norm(ox-cen,axis=1)<np.linalg.norm(elx-cen,axis=1).max()+10
oth=other[keep2].copy(); othx=ox[keep2]
contacts={}
for a in range(len(elx)):
    d=np.linalg.norm(othx-elx[a],axis=1)
    hit=np.where(d<=4.0)[0]
    if len(hit):
        r=int(el.iloc[a].resi)
        for h in hit:
            row=oth.iloc[h]
            kind="rRNA" if row.label_comp_id in NUC else "protein"
            contacts.setdefault(r,set()).add((kind,row.auth_asym_id,row.label_comp_id,row.label_seq_id))
res["n_contact_partners"]=[len(contacts.get(int(r),[])) for r in res.index]
res["contacts_rRNA"]=[sum(1 for c in contacts.get(int(r),[]) if c[0]=="rRNA") for r in res.index]
res["contacts_protein"]=[sum(1 for c in contacts.get(int(r),[]) if c[0]=="protein") for r in res.index]

print("\n==== RESIDUE 38 (the ONLY paralog-discriminating position) ====")
print(res.loc[38][["aa3","aa","iso","cpx","rsa_isolated","rsa_in_ribosome","buried_by_ribosome",
                   "contacts_rRNA","contacts_protein"]].to_string())
print("partners of residue 38 within 4.0 A:", sorted(contacts.get(38,[])) or "NONE")
nb8=[r for r in res.index if abs(r-38)<=4]
print("\nNeighbourhood (34-42):")
print(res.loc[nb8][["aa","rsa_isolated","rsa_in_ribosome","contacts_rRNA","contacts_protein"]].round(3).to_string())
res.round(3).to_csv("eL42_6EK0_per_residue_sasa_contacts.csv")
print("\nChain-level: mean RSA in ribosome %.3f ; residues with rRNA contact: %d/%d"%(
    res.rsa_in_ribosome.mean(), (res.contacts_rRNA>0).sum(), len(res)))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(12,6),sharex=True)
ax[0].bar(res.index,res.rsa_isolated,color="#bbbbbb",label="isolated chain")
ax[0].bar(res.index,res.rsa_in_ribosome,color="#2b6cb0",label="within 80S ribosome")
ax[0].axvline(38,color="#c53030",lw=1.5,ls="--")
ax[0].set_ylabel("relative solvent accessibility"); ax[0].legend(frameon=False)
ax[0].set_title("Human eL42 (RPL36A) in the 80S ribosome, PDB 6EK0 chain Lo\nred line = residue 38, the only position differing from RPL36AL (K38 vs R38)")
ax[1].bar(res.index,res.contacts_rRNA,color="#2f855a",label="rRNA contacts (<=4 A)")
ax[1].bar(res.index,-res.contacts_protein,color="#d69e2e",label="protein contacts (<=4 A)")
ax[1].axvline(38,color="#c53030",lw=1.5,ls="--")
ax[1].set_xlabel("eL42 residue number"); ax[1].set_ylabel("contacting atoms")
ax[1].legend(frameon=False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
